label: 靶场 LV3 · 现代战术步枪与重机枪训练场
designIntent: advance the established shooting-range family from the accepted medieval level-2 compound to a present-day tactical rifle and heavy-machine-gun training facility
retain one uninterrupted roof shared by the attached control room and the open firing stations
keep exactly three readable firing lanes and three fixed steel silhouette targets
add ordered modern ammunition storage and spent-case handling around the facility without blocking any firing lane
retain the stable 2x2 logical footprint and change only the authored visual model
structure: one attached low control building and four firing-line posts under one continuous flat roof
three concrete firing benches separated into exactly three lanes
exactly three fixed steel silhouette targets on one shared target-carrier rail
one connected reinforced-concrete backstop with two short side wings
three attached ammunition lockers, four perimeter supply groups containing exactly eight reinforced ammunition crates, four ammunition cans and three spent-case bins
all components remain inside one complete reinforced-concrete 2x2 foundation
negativeConstraints: no second roof, second building, extra floor, tower, guard post or expanded compound
no fourth target, extra lane, detached bunker, chain-link perimeter, barbed wire, vehicle, radar or antenna
no soldiers, hamsters, people, animals, loose firearms, national insignia, readable text, neon or sci-fi machinery

modelReview.result: the single flat roof, attached control room, three firing lanes, three steel targets, connected backstop and ordered ammunition groups are all readable; the complete reinforced-concrete foundation remains visible and no second building, tower or enlarged footprint is present

structureCandidateReview.result: all three standard raw candidates completed successfully and the user explicitly selected V01 for standard 48-step refinement; rejected V02/V03 candidates and reproducible derived layers were removed after installation

userStructureApproval.scope: approved the complete original V01 raw as the sole init image for the standard two-image 48-step FLUX.2 Dev Depth refinement; no runtime installation was authorized

refinementCandidateReview.recommendation: refine V01 because it retains the approved single roof and three targets while giving the control panels, ammunition crates and safety hardware slightly richer readable detail; refine V02 is marginally cleaner and more restrained
refinementCandidateReview.result: both standard 48-step candidates preserved the selected structure V01; the user accepted refine V01 for Alpha finalization and runtime installation, and rejected refine V02 was removed after installation

userRefinementApproval.scope: accepted the recommended refine V01 and authorized continuing through Alpha finalization and LV3 runtime installation
